name: Recording and capture
notes: Arm, record, stop, memos, tracks, frames, chat, tray

features.feature: The Record pill offers Record next call (Record this call while in one), its language and profile, and Memo; while a call records, the pill holds its language, changed there when it's wrong; "Writing the transcript…" shows beside it while a call is transcribed
Record arms Echo: the pill says "Armed — records the next call" with Cancel; the arm records the next call or expires after 15 minutes
Nothing records without an arm and a call; Ask mode shows Echo's own "Record?" dialog per call, Manual only records when asked
A meeting about to start shows in the pill with its time and Record it

While recording the pill shows a clock and the title (opens the call); Stop asks "Stop recording?" (Stop / Keep recording); Stop ends the recording, not the call, and doesn't record it again; a capture device that hangs (listing, opening or closing it) or Core Audio's list of the app's audio processes that hangs never holds up Stop: the recording ends within seconds, and the call is told from the last answer meanwhile; a Stop while Echo is busy for a moment is kept and ends the recording once it is free, never disarming the next meeting
A memo records the user's mic alone; Stop ends it without asking; its threads come from what was said
A call is two tracks, the mic and the call app's audio (Teams', or Chrome's for Google Meet); a recording's folder is never reused
A short drop and rejoin stays one recording; the call's end stops it after 10 s; a confirmed other call back to back starts a new one
Switching audio devices keeps recording in sync; a track that fails to write notifies once
Muted in Teams, the mic track records silence (with Follow Teams' mute and Read the Teams window on)
The Mac sleeping closes the recording; after a crash the recording is repaired and transcribed on the next start
Shared screens (opt-in) are kept only while someone else shares, one frame per change; frames the minutes don't cite go to the trash for 30 days
The tray icon shows idle, armed and recording; its menu has status, Record, Stop, recent calls and Echo's flows
At first launch macOS asks for Microphone and System Audio Recording up front, and every prompt names Echo
A missing Microphone or System Audio permission is flagged before and during a call, and the other track is still recorded
Recording and transcription work without Microsoft 365 (no Chat tab, no calendar title)
After the call app hangs up, the mic track doesn't fall back to another microphone (the room isn't recorded in the grace or a longer capture)

A recording that starts before the call app holds a mic records silence on the mic track until the app holds one Echo can open; if the app reports none for 10 s (a virtual mic, a listen-only join) it takes the default input and says so in the log
Quitting Echo while a call's transcript is still being finished ends cleanly (no crash at exit): that transcript is made at the next start

A meeting set to record (or armed for that meeting) starts recording only on that meeting's call: the call window naming the meeting, or a call begun from 10 min before it, is its call; a call begun before that whose window doesn't name it (another name, a channel's, none) is another — Echo waits (event arm_waits_other_call, one notification "Waiting to record …"), looks again every few seconds, keeps the arm until the meeting ends, and starts once the user is on its call. A name alone (a renamed or channel meeting) never makes it wait; a window it can't read changes nothing; "Record" on a call already going on records that call

A Google Meet call in Chrome is recorded on a Mac like a Teams call (arm, Record this call, Ask mode, a meeting with a Meet link): Chrome holding the mic is its call only while a Chrome window's title is a Meet tab ("Meet – …"), a calendar meeting with a Meet link goes on (10 min before it to its end) or the arm is for a Meet meeting, and stays its call while Chrome holds the mic; Teams on the mic wins; Chrome on the mic for anything else isn't offered or recorded. The remote track is everything Chrome plays (every tab: "Record?" and a notification at the start say so), meta.json's app is "meet", and nothing is read from Teams for it (no mute, names, shared screens or chat). A meeting's arm starts only on a call of its own app. While a recording is open (its grace after a hang-up too), another app taking the mic is a new call, recorded once that recording has ended (its first seconds may be missed). Two Meet calls back to back are not told apart (one recording)
